catatan: Lanjutan pilihan HIDE IN THE HAUNTED HOUSE: rumah hantu, walkie-talkie Max, labirin cermin penuh Hoppy. Fiksi orisinal, bahasa Inggris USA.

baris.text: Okay. Just stay quiet. It can't find me in here.
baris.arah: (scared breathless whisper, trying to calm himself)

baris.text: Hey... can you hear me? I'm in the mirror room. Come find me.
baris.arah: (teenage boy whispering urgently through a walkie-talkie, scared but hopeful)

baris.text: Over here. Keep walking. You're so close.
baris.arah: (calm and slow, strangely flat and too friendly, slightly wrong)

baris.text: That's not Max... that's not Max!

baris.arah: (deep mascot voice, slow and delighted, sinister whisper)

baris.text: The ride cart! Go, go, go!

noob.desain: (young American teenage boy gamer, about seventeen, casual natural voice, relaxed and a little sarcastic)
noob.ref_teks: Man, this hotel is so quiet tonight. Nobody is in the lobby, and my room is all the way at the top.

max.desain: (American teenage boy, about sixteen, energetic, cocky and funny, slightly raspy voice)
max.ref_teks: Dude, trust me, this is going to be the best video ever. We just sneak in, film the rides, and get out.

hoppy.desain: (deep warm cartoon mascot voice, slow and friendly, like a giant bunny character for kids)
hoppy.ref_teks: Hello there, my little friends! It's me, your best buddy. Are you ready to have some fun today?
